sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_player_pos():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 24:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows), min(cols))
    return None

pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"At {pos}")

# Try SPACE multiple times to see the pattern
for i in range(5):
    result = action(['SPACE'])
    new_pos = get_player_pos()
    print(f"SPACE {i+1}: {pos} -> {new_pos}")
    pos = new_pos
    if result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETE!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
